storia: Nvidia board reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO; scrutiny continues over Trump's role, security clearance and congressional briefings (AP, NYT, WSJ, BBC report; Trump says he 'convinced' Nvidia)
angoli_fatti: Six days after the board said no, one weekend of White House pressure flipped the decision, added nearly $1 trillion in value, and set up a Senate hearing on Dec 3.
novita_oggi: Board faces scrutiny after the 31% surge, with Congress briefed on the Nvidia affair, Democrats demanding answers, and Huang reportedly apologizing and going to therapy (ANSA).
